entry.summary: A temporary speed limit change will be coming into place along part of Eriksen Road (specifically the 450m between the intersection of Kenny Road and the boundary of numbers 46 and 48 Eriksen). The speed limit is being reduced from 100km/h to 50km/h until until Thursday 30 April. The reason? The construction of a new subdivision.
